coinfall-docks.does: Cracks your budget open and scoops up loose coins.
coinfall-docks.effect: Steals 5 coins if you answer wrong.
coinfall-docks.lesson: Spending without a plan drains your savings fast.

coinfall-docks.does: A cloud of tiny bills, each taking a small bite.
coinfall-docks.effect: Eats part of your savings shield.
coinfall-docks.lesson: Small payments that repeat every month add up.

coinfall-docks.does: Grabs everything on the dock with all eight arms at once.
coinfall-docks.effect: Hits twice in a row on a wrong answer.

second_attack.does: A wave of BUY NOW signs rushes at you.
second_attack.effect: Shrinks your answer timer for 1 turn.

the-sprawl.does: Darts in the moment something shiny catches your eye.
the-sprawl.effect: Hits first if you take longer than 10 seconds.
the-sprawl.lesson: Deciding in a hurry leads to choices you regret.

the-sprawl.does: Runs off with one of your choices while you chase a bargain.
the-sprawl.effect: Hides one answer choice for a turn.
the-sprawl.lesson: Make a plan and stick to it.

the-sprawl.does: Spreads a dazzling tail to rush you into a snap decision.
the-sprawl.effect: Asks a bonus riddle; wrong = double damage.

second_attack.does: Tips the scales so both sides meet in the middle.
second_attack.effect: Balances both health bars toward the middle.

frostvault.does: A cold fog that makes every price tag climb.
frostvault.effect: Your coins are worth less until it's beaten.
frostvault.lesson: Inflation shrinks what your money can buy.

frostvault.does: Chips a slice off the coins you earned.
frostvault.effect: Takes a slice of coins you earned this battle.
frostvault.lesson: Take-home pay is less than gross pay, and spending more than you have brings fees.

frostvault.does: Charges harder every turn and wears itself out doing it.
frostvault.effect: Gets stronger each turn but loses health too.

second_attack.does: One huge swing of its icy tusks.

credit-citadel.does: Dives the moment a payment is overdue.
credit-citadel.effect: Extra damage if your answer is slow.

credit-citadel.does: Latches on and drains a little more every turn.
credit-citadel.effect: Damage goes up +2 every turn it is ignored.
credit-citadel.lesson: Paying only the minimum lets interest keep growing.

credit-citadel.does: Clamps one of your answers shut.
credit-citadel.effect: Locks one answer button for a turn.

second_attack.does: Jabs three times in a row.

compound-rift.does: Coils around itself until there are two of it.
compound-rift.effect: Splits into 2 slimes if not beaten in 3 turns.
compound-rift.lesson: Growth builds on growth, for savings and for debts alike.

compound-rift.does: Looks like treasure, swells up, then snaps.
compound-rift.effect: Grows for 2 turns, then pops for big damage.
compound-rift.lesson: If an investment promises quick riches, check it carefully. Bubbles pop.

compound-rift.does: Dives and drags the whole rift down with it.

second_attack.does: A heavy current that slows you down.

the-exchange.does: Charges before you have had time to think.
the-exchange.lesson: Fear of missing out leads to risky choices.

the-exchange.does: A panicked swipe that knocks the power out of your next spell.
the-exchange.effect: Knocks your next spell's power down.
the-exchange.lesson: Panicking in a downturn locks in losses.

the-exchange.does: Brings the whole storm down on you at once.
the-exchange.effect: Huge hit unless Insurance Barrier is up.
the-exchange.lesson: Plan for the worst case. Insurance spreads the cost of a big loss.

phish-fens.does: Dangles a glowing hint that points the wrong way.
phish-fens.lesson: If it sounds too good to be true, it is probably a scam.

phish-fens.does: Steals the letters of one answer and jumbles them.
phish-fens.lesson: Keep your personal information private so nobody can pretend to be you.

phish-fens.does: Spins quietly, then springs the trap.
phish-fens.lesson: Scammers are patient. Stop and check before you click, share or pay.

ledgerhold.does: Fire that keeps burning after the blast.
ledgerhold.lesson: Debt that is left alone keeps growing. Face it early, with a plan.
